description: This file defines a set of React components for rendering breadcrumb navigation UI elements, including breadcrumb container, list, items, links, separators, ellipsis, and current page indicator.

methods.name: Breadcrumb
methods.description: React component for the breadcrumb container, renders a <nav> element with accessibility label.

methods.name: BreadcrumbList
methods.description: React component for the breadcrumb list, renders an <ol> element with styling and className.

methods.name: BreadcrumbItem
methods.description: React component for individual breadcrumb items, renders an <li> element.

methods.name: BreadcrumbLink
methods.description: React component for breadcrumb links, can render as a child component or an <a> element.

methods.name: BreadcrumbPage
methods.description: React component indicating the current page in the breadcrumb, renders a <span> with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
methods.description: React component for separator between breadcrumb items, defaults to a ChevronRight icon.

methods.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
methods.description: React component for ellipsis in breadcrumb, indicating overflow or additional items.
